headline: Court documents: TikTok staff warned execs about child safety risks
summary: Court documents show TikTok employees repeatedly raised concerns about risks to child safety on the platform, including minors evading age restrictions and appearing in sexual content, but executives failed to act, according to records obtained by NPR. TikTok faces hundreds of lawsuits over its safety record.
